programmes.d: An old beer bottle and a fish kettle whet James's appetite for profits in East Sussex and Hampshire, while Irita hopes a 19th century puzzle box solves her auction woes.
Roo Irvine and David Harper go wild in Scotland with treasure, transport and mollusks.
On the fourth leg of their road trip, Thomas Plant has a brush with showbiz and Philip Serrell takes a fancy to some gym equipment.
Antiquers James Braxton and Irita Marriott rummage around the antique shops of Wiltshire and Dorset. Will porcelain or brass bring the experts riches at auction?
From antiques to football feats, Roo and David chase auction glory in northwest England.
Experts Philip Serrell and Thomas Plant make some unlikely purchases on their last road trip and face a nail-biting finale at auction in Greenwich.
Irita and James head to the final auction. Irita's coffers are increasing, but James is hoping an exciting snuff box will make him a small fortune.
The fourth country and finale! Bargains, bugs and a saleroom showdown in Wales.
It's the start of a new road trip as savvy antiques aficionados Mark Stacey and Paul Laidlaw pit their expertise against each other on their journey from Lancashire to Somerset.
Big lumps, tiny mollusks and a very loud motor. Phil and Tahmina shell out in Cheshire.
An all-new adventure for experts Catherine Southon and Serhat Ahmet. Together they head from Kent to the capital in search of the old, the unusual and the precious.
Paul Laidlaw buys some nightmarish figures and Mark Stacey goes retro as the boys travel across the country in style on the second leg of their trip.
Every pick packs a punch for Phil and Tahmina in East Yorkshire.
Antiques experts Serhat Ahmet and Catherine Southon head to the East Midlands in their lilac classic car. They scour the shops for something special to take to auction.
On the third leg of their road trip, Mark Stacey and Paul Laidlaw start their shopping in Stafford and finish with a nail-biting auction in Nantwich.
Squeaky wheels and dainty delights. Phil and Tahmina’s antiques duel hits the Midlands.
Paul Laidlaw gets a peek into the life of the royals and Mark Stacey learns about Pomp and Circumstance on the fourth leg of their road trip.
Antiques experts Serhat Ahmet and Catherine Southon rock their way up the coast of East Anglia in their classic car, on the lookout for local delicacies and money-making bygones.
Tahmina gambles, Phil cheats, but who’ll raise a glass to auction glory in Oxfordshire?
Two antiques experts Mark Stacey and Paul Laidlaw play with boats and helicopters as they storm towards the finishing line of this road trip.
Catherine Southon and Serhat Ahmet need to make their money go a long way on the penultimate leg of their trip. Every penny counts when it comes to making a profit at auction.
Cornwall calls! Will Phil’s mystery gadget or Tahmina’s special stone dazzle at auction?

It's the start of a new road trip and antiques experts James Lewis and James Braxton kick off at Ampthill in Bedfordshire and head for Market Harborough with the popular hymn Amazing Grace ringing in their ears.
As their Road Trip race enters its final lap, there's a chance for antiques experts Serhat Ahmet and Catherine Southon to spend big. But who will take the checkered flag?
Tash and Tim tour the Scottish Highlands, hunting jewels and rewilding the world.
On the second leg of their trip James Braxton and James Lewis travel around Oxfordshire in their classic car in search of bargains to sell at auction.
Dealers Margie Cooper and Paul Martin pick up Edwardian furniture and tribal art on a road trip through Somerset. Margie goes on a safari while Paul is hoping for big profits.
Tim Medhurst hopes his fern fever finds will foil Natasha Raskin Sharp at auction.
Roadtrippers James Braxton and James Lewis head south to the sunshine of Jersey and get a taste of Island life on the third leg of their journey.
Tim falls for a humble pottery lady, but will his dusty crush turn out to be a sleeper?
In Somerset Margie Cooper and Paul Martin hunt for money-making antiques. A toy in perfect condition is a prudent purchase, but will a Victorian toilet mean profit down the drain?
On the fourth leg of their trip James Braxton learns about Faversham's "explosive" history and his opponent James Lewis settles for a nice cup of tea.
Tash and Tim trade banter, bargains and beeps on a coffee-fueled sprint to Edinburgh.
Antique hunters Margie Cooper and Paul Martin head west in search of treasure. Paul buys something no pirate should be without and Margie is drawn to pieces of silver.
In the final dash for the finishing line experts James Braxton and James Lewis head for Leamington Spa in the hope of being crowned road trip winner.
Books, boogies and backstage passes for Tash and Tim’s rock n’ roll adventure.
Anita Manning and Jonathan Pratt embark on a road trip that will take them on a 400-mile journey from Glasgow in Scotland to the Isle of Anglesey.
Paul Martin and Margie Cooper motor through Cornwall, picking up an antique milking stool and very loud 1920's car horn. A detour allows for a quite unusual cup of tea.
Bee Harford straps in for her road trip debut, with old hand Raj Bisram.
Jonathan Pratt visits the world's first savings bank and Anita Manning gets some tips on marriage at Gretna Green on the second leg of their trip.
Margie Cooper and Paul Martin head to Plymouth on their final trip. An eclectic mix of goodies makes for an enthralling auction – but who'll take the crown of top antiquer?
Bee bids big and Raj goes regal. It’s full steam ahead in Hampshire.
Anita Manning and Jonathan Pratt drive from Middleham in Yorkshire through to Halifax in their classic car, looking to make a profit at auction.

Natasha Raskin Sharp and James Braxton compete to find the most profitable antiques in Devon. Their adventure ends up at a vineyard for a spot of wine tasting and auction watching. Will they be toasting success, or drowning their sorrows?
Raj and Bee race through Kent, with cars, Concorde and canines on the menu.
Anita Manning shows an unusual taste in sculpture and Jonathan Pratt opts for something very shapely as the experts head for north Wales.
Natasha and James both buy elephants after scouring the antique shops of Devon and Somerset. The trip takes a dangerous turn when Braxton ends up on a race track in an old banger.
Raj and Bee chase treasure, blow budgets and discover what bears really do in the woods.
On the last leg of their road trip Anita Manning and Jonathan Pratt head for Anglesey for their final auction showdown.
Raj and Bee opt for cuddles, wheels and eco-ink, but who’ll ride away with a win?
Natasha goes wild for chairs and James buys some less-than-pristine items as they explore the antiques emporia of Somerset and Wiltshire.
It's the start of a brand-new road trip and antiques experts David Harper and Catherine Southon journey through Lancashire heading for their first auction in the sea-faring city of Liverpool.
Fern Britton and Phil Vickery visit Devon with Mark Stacey and James Braxton.
Natasha discovers a Dutch masterpiece and has to haggle hard, while James pins his hopes on a naughty dog. Profits are much needed – will Wiltshire deliver?
David Harper goes to jail and Catherine Southon goes to church on the second leg of their antiques road trip through north Wales and Shropshire.
Janice Long and Ken Bruce roam Oxfordshire with Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw.
James explores sheds stacked high with antiques and Natasha has an eye for some art as their tour reaches journey's end in Oxfordshire. Who will come out top dog?
Experts David Harper and Catherine Southon go on a buying spree through mid-Wales on the third leg of their journey from Lancashire to Devon.
David Harper brushes shoulders with a TV classic and Catherine Southon gets a taste for one of Gloucester's finest edibles as they head for auction.
David Harper and Izzie Balmer motor through the Scottish countryside. All hope rests on a little monkey and a Georgian silver fruit ladle making big profits at auction.
Anne Reid and Thelma Barlow join Paul Laidlaw and David Harper for a trip to Oxfordshire.
Catherine Southon gets to dance and David Harper finds himself financially embarrassed as they head for a final auction showdown at Seaton in Devon.
Antiques experts Izzie Balmer and David Harper squeeze into a Mini to explore Scotland. Both find auction-winning items but will the gold brooch make the biggest profit?
Simon Williams and Duncan Preston join James Lewis and Philip Serrell for a trip to Essex.
Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson join forces in a smart classic car for a 500-mile trip from Cheshire to Winchester on the first leg of their journey.
Antiques experts Izzie Balmer and David Harper make their way around Edinburgh and its surrounding towns in their classic car. When the shopping's done, off to auction they go!
Colin Baker and Peter Purves explore Herefordshire and Worcestershire in a Morris Minor.
Charlie Ross goes cricket mad and his rival Charles Hanson goes to the pub and unearths some skulduggery as the pair takes their road trip from Chesterfield to Grantham.
Auctioneer Izzie Balmer and dealer David Harper travel around Fife, Perthshire and Angus searching for profitable antiques. A very rare jar causes excitement at auction.
On the third leg of their road trip Charles Hanson visits the solicitors and Charlie Ross finds history in an old packet of cigarettes.
Tim Brooke-Taylor and Graeme Garden get back into character take to the road in Devon.
Izzie Balmer and David Harper shop for antiques in the Highlands. It's the final leg of their thoroughly enjoyable 'Mini' break and neither wants to say goodbye to bonnie Scotland!
Charles Hanson buys something he doesn't like and Charlie Ross profits from a most unlikely item en route to auction in Ledbury, Herefordshire.
Hermione Norris and John Thomson take a classic car trip through Cornwall.
Roo Irvine and Steven Moore are antiques hunting in the Northeast. Vintage luggage and a pill box surprise at auction, while Steven gets familiar with a Sunderland sailor's story.
Charlie Ross takes an expensive gamble and Charles Hanson gets invited to a castle as they head for the winner's enclosure at auction near Winchester.
On the second leg of their trip, Steven Moore and Roo Irvine are in the Northeast. This time there are underwater treasures, patriotic portraits and the odd bargain. What fun!
